item.name: Physical
item.description: Units with this Archetype deal Physical Archetype damage.
item.stageInteraction: Stage modifiers can boost or cut Physical damage. Check the stage before locking a Physical-heavy board.
item.strength: Gains damage from Physical support auras and performs well on Physical-friendly stages.
item.weakness: Loses output on stages that debuff Physical damage.
item.playstyle: Build around Physical carries when you can place The Hero and the stage does not punish Physical damage.
item.exampleUnits: The Hero, Scissor, 8th Sword (Berserk), Cursed Student (True Love), Hollow (Blaze), Razorjaw (Hunter)
item.cardSummary: Physical damage type that stacks with The Hero's aura, but can be weakened by Physical stage debuffs.

item.name: Magical
item.description: Units with this Archetype deal Magical Archetype damage.
item.stageInteraction: Stage modifiers can boost or cut Magical damage. Avoid Magical stacks on stages that specifically weaken Magical units.
item.strength: Gains damage from Magical support auras and thrives on Magical-friendly stages.
item.weakness: Loses output on stages that debuff Magical damage.
item.playstyle: Stack Magical carries with Forbidden Teacher when you want aura-amplified spell and AoE damage.
item.exampleUnits: Forbidden Teacher, Shadow (Divine), Crimson (Brother), Flame Emperor (Reincarnate), Crow (Black Fire), Elf Mage (Unleashed)
item.cardSummary: Magical damage type that stacks with Forbidden Teacher's aura, but can be weakened by Magical stage debuffs.

item.name: Psychic
item.description: Units with this Archetype deal Psychic Archetype damage. Psychic is the neutral Archetype.
item.stageInteraction: Psychic stays undebuffed by stage modifiers aimed at Physical or Magical damage, so output stays steadier across stages.
item.strength: Never takes Physical or Magical stage debuffs, so it stays consistent when those modifiers appear.
item.weakness: Has no dedicated support unit that raises Psychic damage.
item.playstyle: Bring Psychic units for control and consistency when stages punish Physical or Magical boards.
item.cardSummary: Neutral Psychic damage type that ignores Physical/Magical stage debuffs but has no dedicated damage buffer.
